title: Sandwiches
description: This mod adds sandwiches that gives you effects.
body:
This mod adds sandwiches that gives you effect when you eat them. 

Cheese Sandwich Craft: Bread2x Cheese1x               Effect:None
Chili Sandwich Craft: Bread2x Blaze Dust1x            Effect:Fire Resistance
Strange Sandwich Craft: Bread2x Chorus Fruit1x        Effect:Regeneraion
Mossy Sandwich Craft: Bread2x Vines1x                 Effect:Speed
Frozen Sandwich Craft: Bread2x Snow1x                 Effect:Slow Falling
Dirty Sandwich Craft: Bread2x Brown Mushroom1x        Effect:Night Vision
Cheese Craft: Milk1x (Furnace)
You can place and right click to the sandwich to eat.More sandwiches coming soon. İ hope you enjoy.
